summary: Standards pass: timing. (a) atip_check_26 (a version hang killed at a 1 s limit) failed once in my mutation run, in a run whose mutation does not touch it, while a cargo build ran next to it; it passed alone. (b) The prompt probe has a fixed 5 s limit (min with timeoutSeconds, checks.rs PROMPT_LIMIT): a tool whose start-up takes over 5 s under load is reported as waiting for input, a MUST failure of L0.no-env-switch, and a fixture can only lower it. Neither affects canon today (about 1 s per call). Also: ok-exit/reserved-codes (a reserved code registered with another exit) is judged in L0.ok-exit, which the brief's ok-exit list does not name; spec 7.2.1 marks those four codes L0, so it is accepted.
